config.policy: Isolated grz feasibility experiment, not a production replacement. Every eligible fit/select optical row enters training; fixed parent-selected K and equal iteration budgets. DESI affine slopes fixed; offsets and diagonal excess scatter fitted to paired fit/select data with errors in both systems. Native priors and catch-all inherited identically for controlled diagnostic scoring; no claim of recalibrated probabilities. No downloads. One targeted QSO-only refit after the paired-scatter intervention; other fits are reused explicitly.

validation_config.scope: All test-role rows for native predictive density; reproducible random test subsets for expensive complete-score checks. All held-out overlap QSOs and a saved random background subset for paired scores. No training caps, no probability calibration.

stars.optimizer: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

qso.optimizer: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH
qso.extra_covariance_source: Stellar overlap instrumental residual; QSO variability remains in the population density, not a second added paired-epoch variance.

calibration.scope: Fixed DESI slopes in native asinh coordinates; fit/select offsets and excess variance with both measurement covariances. Extra QSO variance may include variability; no redshift-dependent parameters.

limitations: Native population priors/catch-all inherited for comparison
Fixed affine approximation in asinh space
Raw QSO excess scatter may include variability
Previously inspected examples are regression tests, not untouched data
